name: device-mv-fet
description: gf180mcu medium-voltage MOSFET characterization (nfet/pfet 06v0/05v0/03v3): Vt/Idsat/Ioff/Cgg/Cgd/Ron against the PDK's own published electrical-spec tables. This manifest lets sim/run_corners.py run the same fragment as a generic representative check (Idsat/Ioff at the nfet_06v0 bias point, for --list/--check-env discovery); the authoritative evidence record -- full Vt/Idsat/Ioff/Cgg/Cgd/Ron extraction over the PVT grid, plus the spec Sec 2.2/Sec 7 findings -- is produced by run_device_mv_fet.py, which drives sim/harness's library (pdk.py, corners.py, report.py) directly because DC-sweep-plus-interpolation and BSIM op-point-capacitance extraction do not fit a single tb.json op-point grid.
claim: spec/gate-driver.md#25-device-flavor-decision -- see design/device-characterization.md and run_device_mv_fet.py's records/ output for the full comparison; this manifest's own generic-CLI run reports raw Idsat/Ioff at the nfet_06v0 bias point only.
subset_reason: No supply rail: every DUT is a bare transistor biased from ideal sources, so the +/-10% supply axis has nothing to sweep -- see the 'nosupply' corner-id production in sim/README.md (rails declared empty). run_device_mv_fet.py's own records/ output uses that convention directly (corner-ids like ff_-40c_nosupply, via corners.device_corner_id); this generic-CLI run collapses the (already-absent) supply axis the same way.

idsat_n06_ua.description: sanity range for nfet_06v0 10/0.7 Idsat at |Vgs|=|Vds|=6V; the spread floor proves the MOS .lib sections and .temp actually change the bias point
